cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.30)
project(SDL3_superbuild)

include(ExternalProject)

set(INSTALL_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/install)

ExternalProject_Add(SDL_debug
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/SDL
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_debug/SDL

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/debug
		-DSDL_SHARED=ON
		-DSDL_STATIC=OFF
		-DSDL_AUDIO=OFF
		-DSDL_VIDEO=OFF
		-DSDL_GPU=OFF
		-DSDL_RENDER=OFF
		-DSDL_CAMERA=OFF
		-DSDL_JOYSTICK=OFF
		-DSDL_HAPTIC=OFF
		-DSDL_HIDAPI=OFF
		-DSDL_POWER=OFF
		-DSDL_SENSOR=OFF
		-DSDL_DIALOG=OFF
		-DSDL_TRAY=OFF
		-DSDL_NOTIFICATION=OFF
		-DSDL_TEST_LIBRARY=OFF
		-DSDL_TESTS=OFF
		-DSDL_EXAMPLES=OFF
		-DSDL_INSTALL=ON
		-DSDL_INSTALL_CPACK=OFF
		-DSDL_INSTALL_DOCS=OFF
		-DSDL_INSTALL_TESTS=OFF
		-DSDL_UNINSTALL=OFF
		-DSDL_LEAN_AND_MEAN=ON

	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
)

ExternalProject_Add(SDL_release
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/SDL
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_release/SDL

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/release
		-DSDL_SHARED=ON
		-DSDL_STATIC=OFF
		-DSDL_AUDIO=OFF
		-DSDL_VIDEO=OFF
		-DSDL_GPU=OFF
		-DSDL_RENDER=OFF
		-DSDL_CAMERA=OFF
		-DSDL_JOYSTICK=OFF
		-DSDL_HAPTIC=OFF
		-DSDL_HIDAPI=OFF
		-DSDL_POWER=OFF
		-DSDL_SENSOR=OFF
		-DSDL_DIALOG=OFF
		-DSDL_TRAY=OFF
		-DSDL_NOTIFICATION=OFF
		-DSDL_TEST_LIBRARY=OFF
		-DSDL_TESTS=OFF
		-DSDL_EXAMPLES=OFF
		-DSDL_INSTALL=ON
		-DSDL_INSTALL_CPACK=OFF
		-DSDL_INSTALL_DOCS=OFF
		-DSDL_INSTALL_TESTS=OFF
		-DSDL_UNINSTALL=OFF
		-DSDL_LEAN_AND_MEAN=ON

	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
)
